curves.name: transfer_characteristics_tj_25C
curves.test_conditions: Tj = 25 degC trace (the Tj = 150 degC companion trace lies above it and crosses near -VGS = 2.9 V, -ID = 10 A). The figure states no VDS test condition. Axes plot magnitudes of the negative P-channel quantities.

curves.name: output_characteristics_vgs_minus2p5V
curves.test_conditions: Trace labeled VGS=2.5V (labels are printed with positive numbers although the device is P-channel; the axes are -VDS and -ID, so the physical bias is VGS = -2.5 V). TA = 25 degC per the page header. Label unambiguous: the single mid-level trace, saturating softly and still rising at the right edge.

curves.name: output_characteristics_vgs_minus2p0V
curves.test_conditions: Trace labeled VGS=2.0V (positive-printed label, physically VGS = -2.0 V). TA = 25 degC per the page header. Label unambiguous: the lowest trace, saturating near 0.6 A. Consistent with the Figure 2 transfer curve (about 0.9 A at -VGS = 2.0 V, same order of magnitude).

curves.name: rdson_vs_drain_current_vgs_minus4p5V
curves.test_conditions: VGS = -2.5V and VGS = -4.5V traces are both drawn; this is the clearly labeled lower VGS=-4.5V trace. TA = 25 degC per the page header. Reads about 0.087 ohm at -ID = 3 A, below the p. 1 table maximum of 0.120 ohm, but about 20 percent below the Figure 7 read at the same bias (about 0.108 ohm); Figures 6 and 7 are mutually inconsistent.

curves.name: rdson_vs_drain_current_vgs_minus2p5V
curves.test_conditions: Clearly labeled upper VGS=-2.5V trace. TA = 25 degC per the page header. Note: reads about 0.185 ohm at -ID = 2 A, which exceeds the p. 1 table maximum of 0.150 ohm at VGS = -2.5 V, ID = -2.0 A; the typical curve and the table limit are mutually inconsistent.

curves.name: rdson_vs_vgs_id_minus3A
curves.test_conditions: ID = -3A trace (upper of two nearly merged traces; the ID = -2A companion runs just below it and was not separately digitized because the separation is within reading error over most of the range). TA = 25 degC per the page header. The steep section below -VGS of about 2.6 V carries extra reading uncertainty.

curves.name: body_diode_forward_characteristics_tj_25C
curves.test_conditions: Tj = 25 degC trace (lower/right of the two; the Tj = 150 degC companion lies to its left). extraction_notes: Source PDF SHA-256 verified: 74a1f11c4b2b0d527307d71466917b2ec83f9ddb69b423a7f3e4126a50b19e6b (C118316__SK2301AA.pdf, 4 pages, Shikues (SHIKUES / 时科), REV.08). Identity matches the batch manifest: MPN SK2301AA, manufacturer Shikues, family mosfet, P-channel enhancement mode, SOT-23.

Extraction method: table values transcribed from the p. 1 Electrical Characteristics table via text extraction and a 200 dpi page render; pages 2-3 rasterized at 300 dpi with pdftoppm, each figure cropped and read visually. Curve points are digitized_typical_curve grade; estimated reading accuracy is about half a minor gridline (roughly 5-10 percent, worse on the log-scale body-diode plot and on the steep section of Figure 7).

Sign convention: P-channel device. Tabulated specs are recorded with the datasheet's printed signs (BVDSS -20 V, VGS(th) -0.4 to -1.0 V, VSD max -1.2 V, RDS(ON) conditions VGS = -4.5/-2.5 V and ID = -3.0/-2.0 A). Figure axes are printed as -VDS, -VGS, -ID, -IS, -VSD; curve points are the plotted magnitudes along those negated axes, so the sign is carried by the axis quantity label. Figure 1's trace labels are printed with positive numbers (VGS=2.0V etc.) even though the bias is physically negative.

The table prints no typical values at all (every Typ. cell is '-' or '--'): VGS(th) has only min -0.4 V and max -1.0 V, and both RDS(ON) rows have only guaranteed maxima (120/150 mohm). threshold_typ is therefore null and both rdson_points carry source_kind maximum for the resistance.

No capacitance data is published anywhere in this datasheet: there is no Ciss/Coss/Crss table row and no capacitance-vs-voltage figure, so ciss, coss and crss are null (they would otherwise be recorded in SI farads). Also absent: gate charge, switching times, thermal resistance, avalanche ratings, and power dissipation. Leakage rows published: IDSS max -1 uA at VDS = -20 V; IGSSF max 100 nA at VGS = 10 V; IGSSR max -100 nA at VGS = -10 V; the schema has no dedicated fields for leakage, so they are noted here.

Figure 1 (output characteristics) curves omitted: the four steepest traces share one bunched label 'VGS=3, 3.5, 4V, 4.5V' and are not individually resolvable, so none of them was digitized. Only the unambiguous VGS=2.5V and VGS=2.0V traces are recorded.

Figures 3, 4 and 5 (breakdown voltage, gate threshold, and on-resistance variation with junction temperature) were not digitized: their y-axes are labeled 'Normalized' yet carry absolute units (V, ohm) and implausible tick values (breakdown 22-23.2 V against a -20 V minimum spec; threshold 0.8-1.3 V; on-resistance 0.109-0.122 ohm labeled '-3.0V/-2.0A'), so the intended quantity is ambiguous. They are temperature-variation plots and not needed for DC fitting.

Figure 7's ID = -2A trace was not separately digitized: it runs just below the ID = -3A trace and the separation is within reading error over most of the range; only the clearly labeled upper ID = -3A trace is recorded.

Internal inconsistencies recorded as drawn: (a) Figure 6's VGS = -2.5 V typical trace reads about 0.185 ohm at -ID = 2 A and Figure 7 reads about 0.19-0.25 ohm at -VGS = 2.5 V, both above the p. 1 table maximum of 0.150 ohm at that bias; (b) Figure 6 (about 0.087 ohm) and Figure 7 (about 0.108 ohm) disagree by about 20 percent at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = 3 A magnitude, though both sit below the 0.120 ohm table maximum; (c) the Figure 8 body-diode typical curve reads about 1.9 V magnitude at 1.25 A, exceeding the tabulated 1.2 V maximum magnitude; (d) the Figure 2 transfer curve gives about 4.5-5 A at -VGS = 2.5 V while the Figure 1 VGS=2.5V trace reads 6.4 A at -VDS = 2 V, a mild mutual inconsistency.
No vendor SPICE model or model pack was used; every value comes from the public datasheet PDF.
